description: The gait styles of the walk, run, jog, sprint, sneak and crawl loops of the free Mixamo animation library as FBX files of D:\work\accu\mixamo (one 65-bone rig, the joints' turns retargeted onto the ActorCore skeleton), 64 styles from the walks and runs, read through the ActorCore skeleton (ActorCore_Dummy.glb) by soma's own person import (tools/clip_scan.js's reading, tools/clip_collect.js's ranges): how fast the body goes, how long a step is, how much of a cycle a foot is in the air, how high it lifts, how far the hips bob, when each limb steps, the foot's path and roll and the upper body, in the units of the person (leg lengths, hips' heights, shares of a cycle). Where each comes from: mixamo.sources.json. Made by soma/tools/clip_import/mixamo/.
